cameraRules.aspectRatioStandard: 4:5 Vertical Portrait (512x640 Default) matching Instagram Feed
cameraRules.framingStandard: Flexible Framing Standard: Close-up Portrait (40-50% face) for Profile Avatars/Stories; Medium / 3/4 Body Shot for Feed Posts, Outfits, and Cutscenes.
cameraRules.lightingStandard: Ambient soft diffused light around character (gentle soft light Ambient the girl) + Soft Highlight Roll-off + Smooth Gradient Shadow. Avoid harsh directional spotlights or glowing ambient dust particles.
cameraRules.cameraFilterStandard: ARRI ALEXA 35 with REVEAL Color Science + Tactile 35mm Organic Film Grain (1.2 weight).
cameraRules.backgroundGuard: Always prefix scene context with 'illustrated korean manhwa background, painted webtoon scene' and avoid the word 'realistic' in positive prompts to prevent photorealistic background bleed.
cameraRules.negativeGuard: Must ban flat 2D anime, flat cell shading, simplistic cartoon face, photorealistic, harsh shadow cutoffs, and glowing particles.
